The dashed graph is \(f(x)=|x|\), with its vertex at \((0,0)\).

The solid graph has the same V-shape but its vertex is translated down to \((0,-4)\). A vertical translation downward by \(4\) subtracts \(4\) from the function value:

\[
g(x)=f(x)-4=|x|-4
\]

\[
\boxed{\text{(A)}\ g(x)=|x|-4}
\]
